bot.flat: No change: the grading-day close equals the entry close (baseline_est).
bot.label: Prediction bot: corn, soybeans, Chicago and KC wheat, four weeks out

majority.text: Always say down: the more common four-week move over the backtest window (down in 1,398 of 2,736 weekly cases, Jan 7, 2013 to Aug 31, 2026, ended before the first live call).

daily-old.flat: No change: the price on the judging day equals the price when the call was made (baseline_est).
daily-old.label: Old Daily market call (retired Oct 3, 2026)
daily-old.level: No change: the price when the call was made, which is also the futures price then (baseline_est).
daily-old.majority_none: none: no backtest window before the first call, so not scored

dairy.label: Read my check: the month's Class III price
dairy.level: No change from the last announced Class III price (baseline_est; not on record yet, so not scored). The estimate is itself the futures settle, so the futures baseline is the estimate.

nowcast-dir.flat: No change: USDA's next yield equals its last printed yield (baseline_est).
nowcast-dir.label: Yield nowcast: which way USDA's next corn and soybean yield moves

majority.text: Always say up: the more common direction of USDA's August, September and October yield changes for corn and soybeans, market years 2006/07 to 2025/26 (up 58, down 52, unchanged 6 of 116, from the WASDE archive).

nowcast-yield.label: Yield nowcast: the corn and soybean yield USDA prints next
nowcast-yield.level: No change: USDA's next yield equals its last printed yield (baseline_est). No futures price exists for a yield.

note: Simple baselines for every forecast in forecast-record.jsonl, fixed on the date above. Each forecast is scored beside the best of its baselines, never against a coin flip. A baseline marked none is not scored. These rules are never changed; a new rule would be a new file with its own date.
